parties:
MD.AMIRUL ISLAM
Vs.
MD.SHAHABUDDIN AND OTHERS.
full_judgment: 2. Defendant No. 1; contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all the material allegations of the pre-emption petition and contended inter alia that Fazar Ali was the original owner of the suit land; he died leaving 3 sons and a widow to succeed him ; by amicable partition between the sons of deceased Fazar Ali, Shamsuddin got the case land measuring 73 decimals and 133 decimals other than the case land ; Shamsuddin Sarker sold the case land along with other lands to Hellal Udin; the plaintiff sold 65 decimals of land from the case jote along with other lands to Joynal Abedin and gave possession to him; C and B possesses the land of Khatian Nos. 308 and 321; Altab Ali gifted his portion of land to defendant No. 3 who is his daughter; Shamsuddin Sarker died leaving his wife, 3 sons and 4 daughters to succeed him; by amicable partition defendant No. 2 got 22 decimals of land; within the knowledge of the plaintiff, defendant No. 2 sold the said land by registered deed of sale dated 17.02.1991 plaintiff No. 1 executed a deed of re-conveyance in favour of defendant No. 2; that the plaintiff is well aware of the aforesaid deeds and he filed this case with oblique motives and as such the case is liable to be dismissed.
